properties.value:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <rate-limit calls="100" renewal-period="60" />
    <cors allow-credentials="false">
      <allowed-origins>
        <origin>*</origin>
      </allowed-origins>
      <allowed-methods>
        <method>GET</method>
        <method>POST</method>
        <method>PUT</method>
        <method>DELETE</method>
      </allowed-methods>
      <allowed-headers>
        <header>*</header>
      </allowed-headers>
    </cors>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <forward-request />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <set-header name="X-Correlation-ID" exists-action="override">
      <value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
    </set-header>
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <set-status code="500" reason="Internal Server Error" />
  </on-error>
</policies>
